selection_reasoning: The 'find anvil' task is a straightforward observational task that requires the agent to locate an anvil in the Minecraft environment. It is easily verifiable (the agent must navigate to and look at an anvil), doesn't require deep Minecraft domain knowledge, and can be set up in a scene with clear visual landmarks. As a single atomic task, no dependency edges are needed.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate close enough to the anvil (placed at spawn-relative 6, 1, 6 inside the open-front hut) and face toward it, modeling 'the player can see the anvil'. max_distance=16 allows detection from visual range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at it.

scene_description: A small open-front hut made of oak planks on a cobblestone floor, located ~6 blocks from spawn. The hut has 3 walls (back and two sides) with the front open for easy access. An anvil is placed inside the hut at ~6 ~1 ~6. Two torches mark the approach path. The player must navigate toward the structure and look inside to find the anvil.
task_text: Find the anvil. Navigate to the nearby structure and locate the anvil inside.
design_notes: The hut is positioned at ~4-8 on both X and Z axes, about 6 blocks from spawn. It has 3 walls (south at z=4, east at x=8, north at z=8) with the west face (x=4) having a doorway cut at y1-3 at z=6. The anvil sits at ~6 ~1 ~6 on the cobblestone floor inside. The open doorway faces the player spawn, making the anvil discoverable by walking forward and slightly right. Torches at ~2 ~0 ~5 and ~2 ~0 ~7 guide the player toward the entrance.
